compiled_state.title: As a sprint orchestrator, completion-verifier reads Closure Checks from the dedicated section so transitional one-time checks do not pollute SC validation
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Story

As a sprint orchestrator using the completion-verifier agent, it correctly reads `## Closure Checks` from the dedicated section when present — meaning transitional one-time work (manual steps, migration markers) is evaluated separately from persistent success criteria in `## Success Criteria`, preventing false-positive closures where transitional work obscures unmet SCs.

## Done Definitions

- DD1: `agents/completion-verifier.md` refactored — when evaluating story/epic done definitions, it reads `## Closure Checks` section if present; backward-compat: tickets with no `## Closure Checks` section are treated as having an empty section (pass, not fail)
- DD2: SC3c parent_id-only walk scoped to **criterion enumeration only** — the walk identifies which SC items are present in the ticket body; it does NOT discover which remediation tasks relate to a criterion (that link belongs to `relates_to` edges, not the parent_id walk)
- DD3: SC3c reconciled with Step 3.5 hardcoded SC9/SC13/SC14 gates — the hardcoded gates are extracted to a **pluggable project-hook mechanism**; existing SC9/SC13/SC14 behavior is preserved as the default hook configuration for the calibration epic; hook config key documented in CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md
- DD4: Pluggable project hook interface documented — `project_closure_hooks` config key (or equivalent) defined; hook registration pattern and execution contract specified

← Satisfies: "SC3: completion-verifier updated to read ## Closure Checks section and support pluggable project-specific closure checks"

## Considerations

- **False-positive closure window**: SC3d backward-compat (no `## Closure Checks` = pass) creates a window between S2 shipping and S5 completing bulk migration where any epic lacking the section will pass the new gate trivially. Document this explicitly in the pluggable hook README or release notes. The window is acceptable but must be acknowledged.
- **SC3c enumeration only**: Do not re-implement remediation task discovery via parent_id walk — that logic belongs to `relates_to` edges. The walk must scope strictly to criterion text enumeration from the `## Success Criteria` section of the target ticket.

## Escalation Policy

Escalate when blocked — agents proceed unless a significant assumption is required that could send implementation in the wrong direction. All assumptions made without escalating are documented.
